findings.fix: Remove `role="status"` from this static content, or reserve it for a container whose contents are actually updated by script in response to user action.
findings.violation: `role="status"` designates an ARIA live region for dynamically injected announcements, but this div contains static content present at page load, so the role is misapplied and will not behave as intended for assistive technology.

findings.evidence: `<div class="icon-delete" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Delete item" id="s3-customcontrol">`
findings.fix: Replace the div with a native `<button type="button" aria-label="Delete item">` wrapping the icon.
findings.violation: A delete action is implemented as a `<div>` with `role="button"` and `tabindex="0"` instead of a native `<button>`, so it lacks built-in keyboard activation (Enter/Space) and other native button semantics unless separately reimplemented.
